INFERE: sender attribution: the counterparty account with the most negative balance delta in the same transaction; bounds the distinct-sender count, is not an exact transfer-level decomposition
transfer count: one successful transaction with a positive delta = one transfer; batched or multi-hop routes are not unbundled
MESURE: per-transfer SOL deltas, monthly and window totals, sweep totals, the pass-through residual, and the USD valuation given the stated price source
NON_ETABLI: the purpose of each transfer (proceeds vs returning capital) beyond the candidate count above
any identity behind the sender wallets

price_source: Binance SOLUSDT daily close (api.binance.com /api/v3/klines, keyless); each transfer valued at the close of its own UTC day, never at a window average

return_of_capital_candidates.treatment: included in the totals; published so a reader can subtract them
